name: Solace Throw
description: A soft, substantial throw for slow mornings and long evenings. Woven from a warm merino blend with a gentle, tactile finish.

name: Dawn Vessel
description: A quietly sculptural vessel made by hand in small batches. It is just as lovely holding branches as it is standing on its own.

name: Everyday Tote
description: A generous, hardworking tote in washed cotton canvas. Built for market trips, weekday commutes, and everything in between.

name: Morrow Journal
description: A clear place to begin. Bound in cloth and filled with smooth Italian paper that welcomes every kind of thought.

name: Common Ground Mug
description: A familiar shape, made a little more special. Each porcelain mug is gently speckled and finished with a soft satin glaze.

name: Field Notes Set
description: Three pocket-sized notebooks for lists, sketches, and passing observations. Printed on recycled stock with a tactile uncoated cover.
